name: SeatGeek Platform API
tagline: Ticket marketplace API for events, venues, performers, and listings
description: SeatGeek Platform API provides access to events, venues, performers, and ticket listings data from the SeatGeek ticket marketplace. Developers can search events by location, performer, or date; retrieve venue details; and access ticket listing information with free developer access.

auth.details: Client ID via query parameter or header; self-serve signup

use_cases: get ticket listings for an event
